definitions.binding_path: decision_input.json -> input_digest (inside the report view) -> report_hash -> chain event payload -> chain root
definitions.credential_view: the report with llm_calls, narrative_hash and analysis.llm_narrative removed
definitions.event_hash_recipe: sha256(json.dumps({event_type, payload, prev_hash, timestamp, nonce}, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, default=str).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
definitions.input_canonical_form: keys sorted, compact separators (',' ':'), '_'-prefixed internal keys removed
definitions.input_digest_recipe: sha256(canonical_input.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()  — computed by the engine's _generate_certificate and carried at analysis.ACC.certificate.input_digest
definitions.root_definition: sealed_hash of the last event; an empty chain yields the sentinel ROOT

files.audit_chain.jsonl: the frozen chain, one event per line
files.decision_input.json: canonical input; sha256 of these bytes == input_digest. No trailing newline.
files.report_credential_view.json: canonical credential view; sha256 of these bytes, first 16 hex == report_hash
